newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Piltel up 4.35 pct in mid-session.
newsitem.headline: Piltel up 4.35 pct in mid-session.

text.p: Pilipino Telephone Corp (Piltel) surged by 75 centavos, or 4.35 percent, to 18 pesos on Friday on a technical rebound, brokers said.

"The issue has to be picked up. Investors may be thinking that the issue has reached its bottom and any wise investor would accumulate stocks at their low prices," Elline Salvatierra, Dharmala Securities analyst said.

"Obviously, people are bargain-hunting on the belief that the worse is over for Piltel since it has aggressively cleansed its subscriber base and wrote-off millions of pesos due to fraud and cloning," said Louie Bate, head of sales at ING Baring Securities.
Piltel has been battered by news of its chief financial officer resigning in the midst of the company's cloning problems that resulted in a 740-million peso writeoff in 1996.
Piltel was one of the most actively traded issues on Friday with total volume of shares traded amounting to 2.968 million.
